name: Ubellian Fire Pits
description: One of Tanares’ most treacherous lands, it is a scorching realm of fiery pits and lava rivers and home to several red dragons, including the mighty Avatar Dragon Azymor. The region hosts a noteworthy Dragon Tower, defended by many young dragonborns and dragonblades, as its harsh and isolated environment creates an ideal setting for training recruits. Taii’makus have a good relationship with the tower, and Azymor does not interfere with their traveling. However, other foreigners are not as well received unless they have good standards with the Draconic Council. The Shadow Lords, a sect of the Cult of Shadow Wing, have constantly attacked dragons living here, capturing living individuals and eggs to corrupt them into maddened penumbral dragons. A few penumbral dragons and their servants have taken over some caverns on the western side of the Fire Pits, becoming a threat in the region. Unknown to anyone, the one behind this strategy is Lypoec, who is trying to lure Azymor into an open battle so he can try to take down the Red Avatar Dragon. The Draconic Tower is seeking support from adventurers but is wary of accepting anyone, as the cult is always trying to infiltrate their ranks.
